mapper.select: WITH planned AS ( SELECT d.account_id, d.table_id, d.menu_id, d.menu_name, r.ingredient_id, COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std, r.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, COALESCE(i.base_unit, r.qty_unit) base_unit, i.order_unit, COALESCE(i.convert_value, 1) convert_value, i.welstory_item_code, i.purchase_price, i.package_base_qty, COALESCE(i.safe_stock_qty, 0) safe_stock_qty, COALESCE(i.lead_time_days, 0) lead_time_days, i.max_stock_qty, SUM(COALESCE(r.qty_num, 0) * COALESCE(d.serving_qty, 1)) planned_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r ON r.account_id = d.account_id AND r.menu_id = d.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id = r.account_id AND i.ingredient_id = r.ingredient_id WHERE d.account_id = #{account_id} AND d.table_id = #{table_id} GROUP BY d.account_id, d.table_id, d.menu_id, d.menu_name, r.ingredient_id, COALESCE(i.ingredient_name_std, r.ingredient_name_raw), COALESCE(i.base_unit, r.qty_unit), i.order_unit, i.convert_value, i.welstory_item_code, i.purchase_price, i.package_base_qty, i.safe_stock_qty, i.lead_time_days, i.max_stock_qty ), stock AS ( SELECT account_id, ingredient_id, SUM(current_qty) current_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE account_id = #{account_id} GROUP BY account_id, ingredient_id ), usage_history AS ( SELECT d.account_id, r.ingredient_id, SUM(COALESCE(r.qty_num, 0) * COALESCE(d.serving_qty, 1)) / GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(d.meal_date, '-', ''), '%Y%m%d')), 1) avg_daily_usage, COUNT(*) usage_count FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r ON r.account_id = d.account_id AND r.menu_id = d.menu_id WHERE d.account_id = #{account_id} AND STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(d.meal_date, '-', ''), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL COALESCE(#{average_days}, 14) DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY d.account_id, r.ingredient_id ) SELECT p.*, COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0) current_qty, COALESCE(u.avg_daily_usage, 0) avg_daily_usage, GREATEST(p.planned_qty + p.safe_stock_qty - COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0), 0) shortage_qty, CEIL(GREATEST(p.planned_qty + p.safe_stock_qty - COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0), 0) / GREATEST(p.convert_value, 1)) suggested_order_qty, ROUND(CASE WHEN p.purchase_price IS NULL OR p.package_base_qty IS NULL OR p.package_base_qty = 0 THEN NULL ELSE p.purchase_price / p.package_base_qty * p.planned_qty END, 2) planned_cost, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0) < p.planned_qty THEN 'RED' WHEN COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0) < p.planned_qty + p.safe_stock_qty + COALESCE(u.avg_daily_usage, 0) * p.lead_time_days THEN 'ORANGE' WHEN COALESCE(u.usage_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0) > 0 AND p.max_stock_qty > 0 AND COALESCE(s.current_qty, 0) / p.max_stock_qty <= 0.3 THEN 'YELLOW' ELSE 'GREEN' END stock_status FROM planned p LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.account_id = p.account_id AND s.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN usage_history u ON u.account_id = p.account_id AND u.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id ORDER BY FIELD(stock_status, 'RED', 'ORANGE', 'YELLOW', 'GREEN'), p.menu_name, p.ingredient_name

SELECT h.meal_budget_per_person, COALESCE(SUM(x.serving_qty), 0) total_servings FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT table_id, meal_date, meal_slot, MAX(COALESCE(serving_qty, 1)) serving_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail WHERE account_id = #{account_id} AND table_id = #{table_id} GROUP BY table_id, meal_date, meal_slot ) x ON x.table_id = h.table_id WHERE h.account_id = #{account_id} AND h.table_id = #{table_id} GROUP BY h.meal_budget_per_person
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchase_order_id} ORDER BY client_ord_item
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order (purchase_order_id, account_id, sold_to, client_ord, req_delivery_date, status, welstory_res_cd, welstory_res_msg, client_note, user_id, ordered_at) VALUES (#{purchase_order_id}, #{account_id}, #{sold_to}, #{client_ord}, #{req_delivery_date}, #{status}, #{welstory_res_cd}, #{welstory_res_msg}, #{client_note}, #{user_id}, NOW())

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item (purchase_order_id, client_ord_item, ingredient_id, menu_id, welstory_item_code, order_qty, order_unit, base_unit, base_qty_per_order_unit, item_status, welstory_res_cd, welstory_error_msg) VALUES (#{purchase_order_id}, #{client_ord_item}, #{ingredient_id}, #{menu_id}, #{welstory_item_code}, #{order_qty}, #{order_unit}, #{base_unit}, #{base_qty_per_order_unit}, #{item_status}, #{welstory_res_cd}, #{welstory_error_msg})
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order SET status = #{status}, welstory_res_cd = COALESCE(#{welstory_res_cd}, welstory_res_cd), welstory_res_msg = COALESCE(#{welstory_res_msg}, welstory_res_msg), reconciled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN NOW() ELSE reconciled_at END, received_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RECEIVED' THEN NOW() ELSE received_at END, mod_at = NOW() WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchase_order_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance (account_id, ingredient_id, location_id, current_qty, unit, created_at) VALUES (#{account_id}, #{ingredient_id}, 'L999', #{base_received_qty}, #{base_unit}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_qty = current_qty + VALUES(current_qty), mod_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement (movement_id, account_id, ingredient_id, movement_type, quantity, unit, reference_type, reference_id, movement_at, user_id) VALUES (#{movement_id}, #{account_id}, #{ingredient_id}, 'IN', #{base_received_qty}, #{base_unit}, 'PURCHASE_ORDER', #{movement_reference}, NOW(), #{user_id})
